codes.name: Context_Window_Overflow
codes.definition: Agent cannot process all provided input because cumulative context exceeds capacity, leading to information loss.
codes.when_to_use: When traces are very long (approaching or exceeding model limits) and agent shows signs of losing track of earlier information.
codes.when_not_to_use: When agent successfully processes all information despite long traces, or when forgetting is due to reasoning errors not capacity limits.
detection_heuristics: Trace length in top percentile (p90: 42,210 chars) with median 33,926 chars
Agent references only recent passages while ignoring earlier ones
Agent asks for information already provided earlier in trace
Progressive degradation in analysis quality as trace lengthens

codes.name: External_Retrieval_System_Failure
codes.definition: External retrieval system fails to return passages, returns error, or produces unusable results, blocking pipeline progression.
codes.when_to_use: When evidence indicates retrieval system (external to agents) failed to provide expected passages.
codes.when_not_to_use: When retrieval succeeds but returns irrelevant passages (content quality issue, not system failure), or when agent fails to use provided passages.
detection_heuristics: Coordinator unable to provide passages to agent in subsequent turn
Error messages related to Wikipedia API or retrieval service
Agent receives notification that retrieval returned no results
Expected passage structure absent from coordinator message after retrieval hop

codes.name: Output_Truncation_Mid_Generation
codes.definition: Agent output is incomplete, cutting off mid-sentence or mid-field without proper termination markers. The generation process appears to have stopped prematurely during active output production.
codes.when_to_use: When agent output ends abruptly without completing expected fields or sentences, particularly when mid-sentence truncation is evident or required output sections are partially present but incomplete.
codes.when_not_to_use: When agent intentionally produces short output that is complete for the context, or when output is empty from the start (use A.2 instead).
detection_heuristics: Output text ends mid-sentence without punctuation
Structured fields are started but not completed (e.g., field header present but content missing)
Final output section is partially written then stops
Presence of ellipsis or '[TRUNCATED]' markers in trace
Character count approaches system limits (p90 trace length ~42k chars)

codes.name: Empty_Or_Null_Output
codes.definition: Agent produces no output content, or output fields contain only whitespace/empty values when substantive content is expected.
codes.when_to_use: When agent is expected to generate output but produces nothing, or when all output fields are empty despite having input to process.
codes.when_not_to_use: When partial output exists (use A.1), or when empty output is a valid response to the task (e.g., 'no results found' is appropriate).
detection_heuristics: Output section markers present but no content between them
All structured output fields are empty or contain only whitespace
Agent turn exists but contains no generated text
Workflow proceeds to next step without receiving expected data

codes.name: Task_Execution_Timeout
codes.definition: Agent execution exceeds allocated time budget and is forcibly terminated before completing its task.
codes.when_to_use: When traces contain explicit timeout indicators or when execution appears to halt mid-process with timeout-related error messages.
codes.when_not_to_use: When agent completes quickly or fails for other reasons. Do not use for general slowness without actual timeout.
detection_heuristics: Error message contains 'time out' (observed in 9 traces)
Execution stops abruptly without completion markers
Partial work visible but workflow terminated prematurely
System-level timeout indicators in trace metadata

codes.name: Memory_Exhaustion
codes.definition: Agent exceeds available memory allocation during execution, causing failure or degraded performance.
codes.when_to_use: When traces show out-of-memory errors or when processing fails specifically due to memory constraints.
codes.when_not_to_use: For context window issues related to token limits (use A.5 instead), or for general performance degradation without memory-specific indicators.
detection_heuristics: Error message contains 'oom' or 'out of memory' (observed in 4 traces)
Execution fails when processing large inputs
System reports resource exhaustion
Agent crashes during memory-intensive operations

codes.name: Context_Window_Overflow
codes.definition: Input content exceeds agent's context processing capacity, causing information loss, inability to process all provided data, or forced truncation of input passages.
codes.when_to_use: When agent receives more input than it can process within token limits, particularly visible when later passages in long input sequences are ignored or when agent explicitly indicates it cannot process all provided information.
codes.when_not_to_use: When output is truncated (use A.1), or when agent selectively focuses on relevant passages as appropriate task behavior.
detection_heuristics: Agent processes only early passages and ignores later ones in long input sequences
References to 'too much information' or 'cannot process all passages'
Trace lengths near maximum observed values (max ~47k chars)
Progressive degradation in quality when referencing later input sections
Agent re-requests information that was provided earlier in the same context

codes.name: Repetitive_Output_Looping
codes.definition: Agent generates repetitive or cyclical content, producing the same or highly similar output multiple times without making progress toward task completion.
codes.when_to_use: When agent output contains repeated phrases, sentences, or entire sections that indicate the generation process is stuck in a loop rather than advancing toward completion.
codes.when_not_to_use: When repetition is natural to the task (e.g., iterating through similar items), or when apparent repetition reflects multiple retrieval hops over different evidence (which is expected behavior in this system).
detection_heuristics: Identical or near-identical text blocks appear multiple times in single output
Agent repeatedly makes the same reasoning statements without new information
Circular reasoning patterns where conclusions reference themselves
Repetition detection signals present (observed 100% of traces, though may include false positives from multi-hop structure)

codes.name: Task_Refusal_Or_Abandonment
codes.definition: Agent explicitly refuses to perform the assigned task, states it cannot complete the work, or abandons the task mid-execution without valid justification.
codes.when_to_use: When agent explicitly states it cannot or will not complete the task, provides excuses for non-completion, or stops working without reaching a valid stopping condition.
codes.when_not_to_use: When agent appropriately indicates that provided information is insufficient to answer (which is valid verification behavior), or when refusal is appropriate (e.g., for harmful requests).
detection_heuristics: Output contains explicit refusal language ('I cannot', 'I am unable to', 'This task cannot be completed')
Agent stops mid-task without error but without completion
Refusal/abandonment signals observed in 16/60 traces (26%)
Agent provides meta-commentary about task difficulty instead of attempting solution
Work products missing with explanation that task is impossible

codes.name: Execution_Error_Or_Exception
codes.definition: System-level runtime error or exception occurs during agent execution, causing failure or abnormal termination.
codes.when_to_use: When traces contain error messages, exception indicators, or system-level failure signals that are not covered by more specific codes (timeout, OOM, etc.).
codes.when_not_to_use: When errors are specifically timeout (A.3), memory (A.4), or handled application-level issues. Do not use for agent-generated error descriptions of input quality.
detection_heuristics: Error messages containing 'error:' or 'error (' (observed in 14 traces total)
Stack traces or exception information visible
System-level failure indicators in trace structure
Execution halts with error status rather than completing normally

codes.name: Inter_Hop_Information_Loss
codes.definition: Critical information from previous retrieval iterations is lost or not carried forward to subsequent hops, breaking the chain of reasoning in multi-hop workflows.
codes.when_to_use: When agent in later retrieval hops does not have access to or does not reference findings from earlier hops, causing redundant work or inability to build upon previous discoveries.
codes.when_not_to_use: When agent appropriately focuses on new information while maintaining awareness of prior findings, or when starting fresh analysis is the intended behavior.
detection_heuristics: Agent in hop 2 or 3 re-asks questions answered in hop 1
Conclusions from earlier hops are not referenced in later reasoning
Agent treats each hop independently without building on prior evidence
Summary fields fail to accumulate information across iterations
Redundant entity lookups that could have been consolidated

codes.name: Summary_Insufficient_For_Retrieval
codes.definition: Agent's summary output fails to provide sufficient specificity or explicit entity names needed for the retrieval system to fetch relevant documents in subsequent hops.
codes.when_to_use: When summary fields are vague, omit critical entity names, or don't explicitly identify the specific information needed, causing retrieval system to fetch irrelevant passages.
codes.when_not_to_use: When summary appropriately identifies needed information but retrieval system cannot find relevant documents (that's a retrieval system limitation, not agent failure).
detection_heuristics: Summary uses pronouns or vague references instead of explicit entity names
Summary describes what is needed conceptually but doesn't name specific entities to look up
Subsequent hop receives passages clearly unrelated to claim verification needs
Summary focuses on conclusions rather than identifying missing evidence sources
Agent requests 'more information about X' without specifying what aspect of X or which related entities

codes.name: Degrading_Output_Quality_Over_Iterations
codes.definition: Agent output quality progressively deteriorates across retrieval hops—reasoning becomes less coherent, analysis becomes more superficial, or responses become shorter/less detailed.
codes.when_to_use: When comparing agent outputs across hops shows clear degradation in reasoning depth, coherence, or thoroughness, suggesting accumulating context or fatigue effects.
codes.when_not_to_use: When later hops are appropriately shorter because verification is nearly complete, or when quality varies randomly rather than showing consistent decline.
detection_heuristics: Hop 1 reasoning is detailed and thorough, hop 3 is cursory or superficial
Progressive reduction in output length without corresponding simplification of task
Later hops show less engagement with passage content
Reasoning quality metrics decline across iterations
Increased vagueness or hedging in later outputs

codes.name: Instruction_Drift
codes.definition: Agent deviates from its specified task instructions, answering a different question, following wrong workflow steps, or ignoring explicit constraints provided in the system prompt.
codes.when_to_use: When agent output addresses something other than the specified task, ignores explicit requirements (like 'produce exactly three retrievals'), or follows a different procedure than instructed.
codes.when_not_to_use: When agent interprets ambiguous instructions reasonably, or when deviation is appropriate adaptation to unexpected input conditions.
detection_heuristics: Agent performs different task than specified (e.g., answers question instead of identifying missing evidence)
Explicit constraints violated (e.g., system says 'three hops' but agent stops after one)
Output format differs from specified template without justification
Agent provides meta-commentary about the task instead of performing it
Instructions specify 'identify missing documents' but agent only evaluates claim truth value
